title: First 7 days
summary: Land, sleep, register the essentials. Keep the list short so the jet lag does not win.

items.title: Complete ICA arrival formalities
items.detail: Confirm SG Arrival Card submission before landing and keep your In-Principle Approval (IPA) or pass letter ready at immigration.

items.title: Get a local SIM or eSIM
items.detail: Singtel, StarHub, M1, or MVNOs at Changi or nearby malls. You will need SMS for banking and OTP-heavy apps.

items.title: Confirm temporary housing keys and Wi-Fi
items.detail: Serviced apartment, hotel, or host address — note gate access codes and the building’s visitor policy.

items.title: Message HR / relocation contact
items.detail: Confirm first-day logistics, pass collection appointment, and any medical checks still pending.

items.title: Load SimplyGo / contactless transit
items.detail: Link a contactless card or get an EZ-Link. Grab and Gojek work for the first week if you prefer doors-to-doors.

items.title: Locate a nearby GP clinic
items.detail: Save one polyclinic or private GP within a short walk or bus of where you are sleeping. Jet lag plus humidity is a classic first-week combo.

items.title: Do a small grocery and hawker recon
items.detail: Cold drinks, fruit, and one neighbourhood hawker centre. You do not need to master Singapore cuisine on day two.
